## No AI Compliance Checklist

FED TTS follows a strict "No AI" philosophy. All changes must comply:

- [ ] No neural networks or ML models introduced
- [ ] No cloud API calls added (all processing is local/offline)
- [ ] No LLMs or generative AI used
- [ ] All new functionality works with deterministic algorithms
- [ ] No new dependencies on AI/ML libraries (e.g., no torch, tensorflow, transformers)
